sessions_subject.name: sessions_subject
sessions_subject.value:
("sessions"."kind" = 'staff' AND "sessions"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."visitor_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("sessions"."kind" = 'visitor' AND "sessions"."visitor_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("sessions"."kind" = 'registrant' AND "sessions"."otp_challenge_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sessions"."user_id" IS NULL AND "sessions"."visitor_id" IS NULL)

visits_other_reason_details.name: visits_other_reason_details
visits_other_reason_details.value: "visits"."reason" <> 'other' OR ("visits"."reason_details" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("visits"."reason_details")) >= 3)

visits_rejection_reason.name: visits_rejection_reason
visits_rejection_reason.value: "visits"."status" <> 'rejected' OR ("visits"."rejection_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "visits"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

visits_approved_window.name: visits_approved_window
visits_approved_window.value: "visits"."status" NOT IN ('approved', 'checked_in', 'completed', 'expired') OR ("visits"."entry_window_start" IS NOT NULL AND "visits"."entry_window_end" IS NOT NULL AND "visits"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

visits_checked_in_fields.name: visits_checked_in_fields
visits_checked_in_fields.value: "visits"."status" NOT IN ('checked_in', 'completed') OR ("visits"."checked_in_at" IS NOT NULL AND "visits"."check_in_gate_id" IS NOT NULL)

visits_completed_fields.name: visits_completed_fields
visits_completed_fields.value: "visits"."status" <> 'completed' OR ("visits"."checked_out_at" IS NOT NULL AND "visits"."check_out_gate_id" IS NOT NULL)
